name: Crosswind Pillars
design_intent:
CROSSWIND PILLARS — THE HIGH WIRE #15 (tier 3, tall pillars + ONE lethal hammer up high). Four spire-tops over a starfield void, 600px gaps, with ONE lethal spinning hammer mounted over the central-high spire (S2) — the ONLY machine in the whole circuit. The exposure identity holds (the void is still the main killer); the single high rotor adds a dodge-or-die beat over the contested high pillar and a way to knock a rival into the blade. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: exposure geometry with a single lethal accent up high (its JSON-ONLY sibling stagger_spires is bare). Feel = 'contest the high pillar under the blade, then knock them into it or off into the deep.'

DOCTRINE FIT (v6 §2.0): the hammer is TELEGRAPHED (period 4.5, arc 150 < 360, ~1.08s apex dwell = the clear beat) and FAIR (mounted over S2 only; S1/S3/S4 are always clear refuges; no spawn under it). A hammer kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall; a knocked/tagged victim within the 6s window is credited. No fenced constant touched.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 600px in ~0.9s; super 2800 clears all). Spires S1(0..480 top1040) S2(1080..1780 top560, the hammer deck) S3(2380..2860 top1040) S4(3460..3940 top640):
- GAP S1<->S2 / S2<->S3 / S3<->S4: each edge gap = 600px over the void, most with a 400-480px vertical offset (a diagonal arc). 600 > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED on every crossing; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- DODGE the blade on S2: the sweep's apex dwell (~1.08s) is the clear window; a mistimed step into the central strip at body height = instant off-screen kill. The blade's arc over the gaps rides HIGH, above crossing altitude, so it never makes a required crossing uncrossable, and S1/S3/S4 stay clear. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- CLIMB onto the high hammer deck S2 (top560): 480px above the low spires (S1/S3 top1040) AND across a 600px gap. JETPACK REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: low spire bottom 1096 -> bottom blast line 2000 = 904px of open sky (>= 650, Rule D) -> a fuelled knock boosts back to a spire. Verb: FLY.
- Zero-boost from any spire reaches no neighbour across a 600px gap; the jetpack is required to move at all, and the hammer only reshapes/times the fight on S2. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing, not scenery.
